{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Aemeath |language = en |name = Aemeath |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = How did I come up with the name Fleet Snowfluff? Totally random! It just popped into my head while I was registering a domain for my site. But hey, I did go all out on that digital Snowfluff Seal design! My fans even turned it into official merch, and the price on these in the marketplace is through the roof! Crazy how my merch just flies off the shelf, even when I'm long gone. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = In the depths of the Void Storm, sometimes I catch that "eye" staring back at me, with all its void and craving for death, senseless and silent. This is the perilous world the students of Startorch long to explore. From one prodigy to the next, they go on their trek for the truth like moths to flames. Do I see myself among them? Haha, how would I know? I'm just a student going through my sentimental phase. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = I remember how you used to tell me stories on stormy nights like this, when memories of my parents' disappearance glared awake in me. You'd hold my hand until I fell asleep. The warmth from your palm quieted down my fears. I used to love your stories for their twists and turns, danger and thrills—until it dawned on me they were from your own experiences. And then I told myself, "I don't want to hear these stories anymore. All I want... is for you to live safe and happy." |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = When I learned the truth about you, the first thing I felt was anger. The more warmth you showed me, the more my hatred grew toward the things that caused you pain. I was furious, wishing I could cut apart those wretched things like you showed me. It's only been a few decades since I became a ghost, but it's become increasingly difficult to keep the loneliness at bay. To think that... the endless time that flowed through you—You came to this world in solitude, do you intend to depart in that way, too? |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I know being a savior isn't as glorious as it sounds. The title is too heavy to bear and only the bigheaded would say otherwise. But still, I want to be someone who protects this world. It's such a great burden, but it might be easier if you let someone shoulder it with you. So, I'll be bigheaded. And I'll walk beside you, down the same path you've always walked, until the tomorrow you longed for finally dawns. |vo_02_01_title = {character}'s Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = My hobbies usually don't stick around for long. I get along with everyone at the Academy, so I often help out with their club activities—it's a great way to try all sorts of things. If I have to say... It's more the buzz of getting together that I enjoy rather than the activities themselves. It's all about living "a carefree, happy life," isn't it? |vo_02_02_title = {character}'s Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = A classmate from Huanglong once taught me a local saying: "Nothing but death is worth a moment's thought." It's true—death put everything in perspective. What troubled me in the past looks trivial now. Aside from protecting the world, the only thing I still worry about... is you. |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Students at Startorch come from all over the world, and many bring along special delicacies and recipes from their hometowns. Food review posts are always trending on the Academy Forum, and if you ask me, I'm always up for trying out the latest food fad! |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = Nope. As long as it's food, me likey. Though... I don't really need to eat anymore, haha. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = I want to be like you—to become the savior. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = I designed the mech based on the Exostrider's operating codes. Being a digital ghost means I can merge into its control system. So, it sort of looks like it's on autopilot once I'm inside. I've stored part of my computational power inside its body, so it can fight alongside me whenever I need support. Gotta make the most of being a digital ghost, right? |vo_03_01_mention = Exostrider |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = To stop the Threnodian from breaking the seal, I resonated with the Exostrider in the cockpit. My body was torn apart in excruciating pain, but my mind was alight with an almost blissful thrill. I'd always tried to follow your advice, to live as an ordinary, happy student. But at that moment, your words no longer bound me. I could finally do what I'd always wanted—to save the world. Haha… what a foolish, arrogant, greedy dream I had. And yet, look at me. I actually made it come true. |vo_03_02_mention = Exostrider |vo_04_01_title = About [[Mornye]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Mornye.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = The first time I met Professor Mornye was when you took me to the Academy, right before you left {{Extra Effect|Lahai-Roi|Lahai-Roi|A civilization located at the polar region of Solaris. Ancient shifts in the planetary axis redefined the world's geography, turning the Lahai-Roi region into what is now the planet's pole. Over time, the vast caverns deep beneath thick layers of ice and snow gradually became habitable for humankind. In this warm and humid underground haven stands an academic metropolis for Resonators, celebrated as the "Research Haven of Solaris" and a "Utopia for Researchers."}}. She was your junior back then, sitting quietly in her wheelchair, always stealing glances at you. Every time she tried to speak to you, she'd instinctively bury her head into those papers in her hand before she could utter a word. Urgh, the spell you obliviously cast by being gentle to everyone you meet. Works every time. |vo_04_01_mention = Mornye |vo_04_02_title = About [[Luuk Herssen]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Luuk Herssen.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Dr. Luuk is kind and competent, admired by many students. But he wasn't always this way. He used to carry a constant tension, as if bracing for battle at any moment. Perhaps the change came when you invited him to {{Extra Effect|Lahai-Roi|Lahai-Roi|A civilization located at the polar region of Solaris. Ancient shifts in the planetary axis redefined the world's geography, turning the Lahai-Roi region into what is now the planet's pole. Over time, the vast caverns deep beneath thick layers of ice and snow gradually became habitable for humankind. In this warm and humid underground haven stands an academic metropolis for Resonators, celebrated as the "Research Haven of Solaris" and a "Utopia for Researchers."}}. Offering his service at the Academy gradually taught him to trust and allowed him to finally feel the warmth of sunlight again. |vo_04_02_mention = Luuk Herssen |vo_04_03_title = About [[Shorekeeper]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Shorekeeper.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = On nights filled with your sighs, I used to sneak near your desk, catching snippets of your conversations with her. Shorekeeper… yes, that's her name. Whenever you talked with her, the weight in your breath would lift. I think she must be the one whose been watching over you, offering solace and quiet comfort. |vo_04_03_mention = Shorekeeper |vo_04_04_title = About [[Camellya]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Camellya.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = I used to chase {{Extra Effect|Exoswarm|Exoswarm|Biomechanical creatures formed from the Exostrider's cellular remnants. By mimicking herds and other lifeforms, they helped rebuild Lahai-Roi's ecosystem.}} across the frostlands with Camellya! She's really good at gaming, too. Ha, I wish we could gather for a rematch someday. But I found out she actually slipped away from {{Extra Effect|the Black Shores|The Black Shores|Solaris' foremost authority on observing the Lament cycle.
Through constant observation and analysis of Lament's shifting patterns, this organization predicts and warns of impending manifestations before they occur.}} on her last visit while she was supposed to be recuperating. She came all the way just to check on you, only to leave without a word, when she saw that you were okay. Camellya's health has always been a bit unstable, so make sure to check on her whenever you can, alright? |vo_04_04_mention = Camellya |vo_04_05_title = About the [[Exostrider]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Exostrider.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = For years after becoming a digital ghost, I would journey to the frostlands just to see it. It always stood there—silent, motionless in the snow—and I would stand beside it, quietly watching. At a time before the dawn of {{Extra Effect|Lahai-Roi|Lahai-Roi|A civilization located at the polar region of Solaris. Ancient shifts in the planetary axis redefined the world's geography, turning the Lahai-Roi region into what is now the planet's pole. Over time, the vast caverns deep beneath thick layers of ice and snow gradually became habitable for humankind. In this warm and humid underground haven stands an academic metropolis for Resonators, celebrated as the "Research Haven of Solaris" and a "Utopia for Researchers."}}, what made it decide to take out its {{Extra Effect|Reactor Drive|Reactor Drive|The Exostrider's power core and Lahai-Roi's underground "sun."
Royan records say this energy entity was removed from the Exostrider and placed underground to sustain the haven. However, monitoring data confirms a gradual but steady decline in its energy output. Both the Roya and the Spacetrek Collective are now formulating emergency contingencies in response.}} to illuminate this land? {{Extra Effect|Exostrider|Exostrider|A colossal mech of alien origin, now dormant in the Roya Frostlands. Startorch Academy was founded to train Synchronists capable of establishing Augmented Resonance with it. In the Roya's Trine Myth, it is revered as Baldur, the earthly incarnation of the sun deity Sol. Legend claims it once held up the earth's collapsing crust with its greatsword, saving the Roya from annihilation. Predictions foretell it will awaken from its slumber to confront the ruinous Hvedrungr in a final, apocalyptic battle.}}... you came from the same place. So how... why did you make that choice? |vo_04_05_mention = Exostrider |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Look what I got you—a limited Snowfluff Seal cake! Isn't it just the cutest thing ever? Haha, finally, I get to celebrate your birthday in this cabin again. Birthday, huh… I wonder if back where you came from, they had any fun celebrations for you. I hope they did! Okay, all candles are lit. Close your eyes and make a wish! I wish that all your wishes come true, and that I get to sing you happy birthday every year from now on. Please remember this: no matter how far you go, your family's here to give you support and love. Forever and always. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Give it a try? Like this. Here.
It flew so far! Impressive! |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = Look over here! |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = Exostrider Armament: Running self-diagnosis.
Aemeath: Mm, all systems green. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = Aemeath, {{Extra Effect|Synchronist|Synchronist|Candidates selected from across Solaris who can link their consciousness to the giant Exostrider mech via an external mechanical interface.
These Synchronists can achieve a degree of control over the Exostrider through Augmented Resonance. To identify and train these rare pilots, Startorch Academy established Rabelle College.}} of the {{Extra Effect|Exostrider|Exostrider|A colossal mech of alien origin, now dormant in the Roya Frostlands. Startorch Academy was founded to train Synchronists capable of establishing Augmented Resonance with it. In the Roya's Trine Myth, it is revered as Baldur, the earthly incarnation of the sun deity Sol. Legend claims it once held up the earth's collapsing crust with its greatsword, saving the Roya from annihilation. Predictions foretell it will awaken from its slumber to confront the ruinous Hvedrungr in a final, apocalyptic battle.}} from Rabelle College. That was me back when I was alive. Now? I'm a digital ghost! |vo_07_01_mention = Exostrider |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Did you see me? |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = I destroy all that seeks destruction. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Here comes the ghost, boo— |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Let's go save the world! |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = Mech performance upgraded! |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = May this strength help the {{Extra Effect|Exostrider|Exostrider|A colossal mech of alien origin, now dormant in the Roya Frostlands. That's why I've been working on new laser beam arrays! |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = You taught me well, but I've added a few creative twists to your technique. Now's the perfect time to test it out! |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = I hope I'm strong enough to walk beside you now. It's good to have someone to follow and rely on, but I want more than that.
